Synthetic cohort only — outputs are **not** paper results.

- **Part A:** merged pathway GAM (`k = 7` + `batch`; ribbon at batch `ROSMAP`)
- **Part B:** cohort `Ast.10` / `sqrt.amyloid_mf` GAMs (no batch, no `k`)

CLI equivalent: `Rscript notebooks/01_pathway_gam_dataset_batch.R` (from `DeepDynamics/analyses/`).

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE, message = TRUE, warning = FALSE)
knitr::opts_knit$set(root.dir = normalizePath(".."))
```

```{r run}
source("notebooks/01_pathway_gam_dataset_batch.R")
```

## Part A — merged pathway

```{r part-a, fig.width=5.5, fig.height=3.5}
print(p_a)
```

## Part B — cohort cell state and pathology

```{r part-b, fig.width=10, fig.height=3.5}
print(p_ast + p_amy)
```
